tip.palette.title: Command palette
tip.palette.text: Space or Ctrl+K finds any command from a few letters. Frequent commands rise to the top.
tip.args.title: Commands with values
tip.args.text: Type values right in the palette: “wall 300 concrete”, “door 900x2100”, “column 3000 @Level 2”.
tip.repeat.title: Repeat
tip.repeat.text: Enter in an idle view repeats the last command with the same values. Recent ones sit in the bar at the bottom left.
tip.menu.title: Right click
tip.menu.text: Right-click an element for a menu of its category: select similar, isolate, hide, type, parameters, delete.
tip.hud.title: Properties at the cursor
tip.hud.text: Key parameters of the selection appear by the cursor. Type a value and press Enter — no properties panel needed.
tip.multi.title: Many elements at once
tip.multi.text: With several elements selected, differing values show as “<varies>”; a new value goes to all of them in one undo step.
tip.chain.title: Connected walls
tip.chain.text: Select a wall and press SJ for the whole connected network; Tab cycles the elements under the cursor.
tip.sets.title: Selection sets
tip.sets.text: SV saves the current selection, SQ brings it back; SP restores the previous selection.
tip.history.title: History
tip.history.text: Ctrl+Shift+H lists the steps; click one to take the model back to it. After a command, “Undo” waits at the bottom.
tip.keys.title: Your own keys
tip.keys.text: Ctrl+Alt+K assigns chords and two-letter keys, shows conflicts, exports and imports the map.
